Got it, 2.4M USD for Q3. I'll note that.

I don't have his calendar, but I can remind you to ping him.
不用了，我直接找他
Omar说有个enterprise deal可能提前，要准备一下
Let me know if you need any prep support.

aicoo, 帮我check一下Ben这个季度的pipeline

Great, forward it to the team if needed.

At least the aircon is good there. Get some iced kopi.
晚上跟Omar吃饭，聊聊那个enterprise deal
Enjoy the dinner and good luck with the deal.
aicoo, 早上好，今天好多会

好的，我会在Friday前remind you to send那份budget breakdown.

收到，我准备一个draft

Yuki太棒了，23%很厉害

哈哈，做好防晒！今天有什么安排？
aicoo, 帮我和Omar说一声，I'll review his Singapore pipeline next Monday
Got it, 我会通知Omar你next Monday要review他的pipeline
刚和Singapore team开了standup, 他们状态不错
好，你那边也顺利

需要我highlight关键点吗？
下午和Ravi sync一下，看看integration timeline能不能align
好，我帮你准备agenda
今天早点收工，女儿还有点咳嗽，回家看看
嗯，回去陪陪她，早点休息
aicoo, don't forget to remind me to check Ravi's integration progress on Sep 1.
Sure, I'll remind you on Sep 1 about Ravi的integration progress.

Yuki做得好！那个lift很solid。

需要我帮你set up time with Ben吗？
先不用, 我下午自己找他
Aurora Health那笔deal, Lily说legal review还要一周, 有点担心timeline
Keep pushing, 800K值得盯紧。
老妈今天血压又高了, 晚上得早点回去
照顾好妈妈, 工作这边我帮你留意。
Booked flight to Singapore for Sep 1, need to visit Omar's team那边。
收到, Sep 1飞新加坡, 我帮你记上。
Ravi说integration timeline on track, 但test环境有点问题
希望他能在Sep 15前搞定。
Grace刚Slack我, 问Q3 pipeline, 我回了个summary
那就好, 她应该满意。
下午和Omar打了个call, 他说Singapore team的pipeline有点weak
那你Sep 1过去正好boost一下。
女儿今天学校有活动, 老婆带她去, 我miss了, 唉
工作太忙了, 下次争取去。

15% increase, 不错！Q4可以多推一些。
Aurora的legal review还是没消息, 我让Lily去follow up
催一下, 别拖太久。
Ravi在integration上卡了一个dependency, 说可能要delay一周
那得跟他align一下, 看看怎么mitigate。
下午和Ben开了个会, pricing review的改动他同意了, 下周推
Good, 终于往前动了。
老妈今天好点了, 但医生说要继续观察
那就好, 继续留意。
今天一早收到老爸住院的消息, 唉
哎, 严重吗？需要你过去吗？
应该稳定了, 但得去医院看看
Ben, 今天pricing review的会你来lead, 我这边实在走不开
Omar, 新加坡那边你先自己review pipeline, 我Sep 1过去再细聊
Lily, Aurora的legal review你盯一下, 有update告诉我
看起来今天你要focus on family, 工作我帮你keep track.
刚去医院回来, 老爸情况稳定了, 但得住院几天
那你就多陪陪, 工作这边暂时放一放。
老爸又进医院了, schedule for this week完全被打乱, Ben take over the pricing review.
明白了, Ben会handle pricing review, 你安心照顾爸爸。
aicoo, 早安. 周末还要看一下Aurora deck, 下午去医院看我爸. 你先帮我记一下: 周一早上跟Lily sync Aurora legal status.
早安 Kai. 记住了: 周一早上跟Lily sync Aurora legal status. 希望你爸爸情况好转.
Omar发了个email, 说Singapore那边有个新机会, 大概200K ACV, 要不要在Q4铺进去? 我让他先发pipeline summary.
好的, 等Omar的pipeline summary再看. 200K听上去不错.
医院回来路上, 我爸稳定了但还要观察两天. 下午抽空看Ben的pricing model了.
稳定就好, 你也要休息.
Ben的pricing model v1有bug, 算出来unit economics不太对. 我让他redo.
让Ben把假设也写清楚, 方便review.
今天不work了, 陪女儿一会儿. 晚安aicoo.
晚安Kai, 好好休息.
Sunday早起, 去医院前把Aurora deck finalize掉. 一小时后发给你review.
好的, 我等你.
Deck发你了. 首页financial summary那里你检查一下数字: 800K/3yr, 第一年400K upfront, 剩下按季度.
数字正确, 400K upfront + 4 x 100K quarterly. 没问题.
刚医院出来, 我爸可以吃流食了, 医生说再观察两天. 下午来公司做点cleanup.
good news. 希望早日出院.
Just got pricing model v2 from Ben, plan to launch 39 per user per month.
39 per user per month — 比之前41低了5%. 需要跟Grace确认? 还是直接走?
我先找Grace聊一下 这周pricing council meeting, 然后同步Sales.
整理了一下Q3剩下6周的priority list. 1. Aurora close, 2. Pricing launch, 3. 新加坡pipeline review (Sep 1 trip). 4. Ravi integration. 你觉得missing什么?
Yuki的onboarding redesign rollout 要不要加进去? 她说23% lift, 应该排priority?
对, 加进去, 排在pricing之后. 谢谢提醒.
明天周一, 准备开战. 晚安.
晚安Kai, 明天见.
aicoo, 早上好. 今天主要任务: 9点跟Lily sync Aurora legal, 10点跟Ravi standup, 下午跟Grace过pricing.
早上好. 9:00 Lily sync (Aurora legal), 10:00 Ravi standup, 下午 Grace pricing. 收到.
Lily说legal review这周能出结果, Aurora那边看起来positive. 但客户想要一个custom analytics module, 得先评估scope.
custom analytics module — 要跟Ravi确认engineering capacity.
Ravi standup结束了. Integration on track for Sep 15, 但他提到了一个第三方API deprecation issue, 需要alternative.
API deprecation — 需要Ravi给出timeline for switch. 你让他plan了吗?
aicoo, PR descriptions以后always end with a Risk section.
收到了. 所有PR descriptions都加Risk section, 以后常驻.
午饭时间, 顺便跟Yuki聊了一下onboarding rollout plan. 她说下周一beta release, 需要QA support.
下周一的beta — 跟Ravi确认QA资源.
Grace对pricing 39 per user per month没有意见, 但要求我们做一个competitive analysis, 下周五present.
competitive analysis due next Friday. 我会提醒你.
今天OK了. 明天继续. 晚上去医院看我爸.
好的Kai, 明天见.
aicoo, 早. 我爸医院说今天可以出院了, 太好了. 上午我会晚点到, 先去接他回家.
太好了！恭喜. 接爸爸回家最重要.
到公司了. 先看邮件, Lily说Aurora deal legal cleared, 但客户签字前还有一个小条款.
小条款是什么? 严重吗?
Lily说Aurora deal可能会有scope change，要加custom analytics module.
custom analytics module — 之前提过. 需要评估effort和定价影响. 你让Lily拉Ravi一起讨论?
对, 我让她下午跟Ravi约个会. 这个module如果影响Q3 close, 可能得重新negotiate terms.
Ben发了pricing migration plan, 分3个phase: 现有客户grandfather, 新客户immediate, 年底统一. 你看看?
Phase 1: grandfather existing, Phase 2: new customers at $39, Phase 3: unified by year-end. 逻辑清楚, 但需要确认support teams准备好了.
Lily和Ravi的会开了, 结论: custom analytics module大概需要2-3 sprints (6-9 weeks). 意味着不能包含在现有deal里.
6-9 weeks — 那Aurora得签两份合同: 主deal 800K + 后加的module? 还是改成phase 2?
我刚跟Lily说, 建议把module作为optional add-on, Q1 2027 delivery, 单独定价. 不然Q3 close risk太大了.
逻辑合理. 让Lily准备proposal给Aurora.
今天早点走, 回家陪爸爸吃晚饭. 明天继续.
享受家庭时光. 明天见.
aicoo, morning. Can you remind me to check with Ravi on the security audit timeline? I think it’s dragging.
Good morning, Kai. I’ll set a reminder for you to check with Ravi on the security audit timeline today.
Lily说Aurora那边legal review还没动，我让她今天escalate一下。
Good, following up with Lily on that escalation keeps the deal on track.
Yuki的dark mode request有3个客户提了，我待会儿把list给她。
Great, Yuki will appreciate the specific customer feedback for dark mode.
Omar's Q4 budget increase is confirmed? 我周一跟他sync一下新加坡的数字。
It was confirmed last week at 15% increase. Sync with Omar Monday sounds good.
Ravi刚才说security audit可能会影响integration rollout，but he's hoping Sep 15 still holds.
Hope so. Let’s keep an eye on it; you have the Sep 15 deadline in your notes.
Lunchtime. Dad's doing better, mom血压今天正常了。
Glad to hear your dad is better and your mom’s blood pressure is stable today.
Ben的pricing review meeting moved to next Wednesday. 我让他update deck。
Got it, I’ll update your calendar for next Wednesday’s pricing review with Ben.
Ben的pricing review meeting moved to next Wednesday.
Noted, Kai. I’ll keep that rescheduled for next Wednesday.

Reminder set for tomorrow morning’s customer interview – note down feature requests.
I need to review Lily's Aurora pricing add-on proposal before Friday, reminding myself.
I’ll remind you Thursday afternoon to review Lily’s Aurora pricing add-on.
Morning，让我看看今天customer interview的notes。
Morning, Kai. I have the interview notes ready whenever you are.
Customer interview里有3家requested dark mode，记下来给Yuki。
Noted. Three customers requested dark mode – I’ll flag that to Yuki.
Also one customer mentioned the onboarding flow is still confusing, 跟Yuki说一下。
Will do – I’ll share that onboarding feedback with Yuki as well.
Ravi刚发了security audit的preliminary findings，他says可能delay integration。
I see. Let me know if you want me to track a new integration deadline based on the audit.
Grace wants a Q3 progress summary by next Friday, 我得开始整理了。
I can help you draft the Q3 progress summary. Just let me know the key sections.
Lunch break, 女儿今天幼儿园有活动，送她去了才来。
Sounds like a good morning. Hope she had fun at the activity.
Omar新加坡pipeline review我改到Thursday下午了，你帮我发个invite。
I’ll send the invite for Thursday afternoon with Omar for the Singapore pipeline review.

Good. Pushing on legal now will help keep the Q3 close on track.
明天周五，but I have back-to-back internal reviews，好累。
You’ve got this. I’ll keep your reminders short tomorrow to help you breathe.
Friday, need to get through pricing review prep and Yuki's design sign-off.
Two key items. I’ll check in with you after each.
Yuki's onboarding redesign is basically done, just need to A/B test the new version.
Great progress. A/B test next week should give you solid data.
Ben's pricing v2 deck looks solid, $39/user/month, but we need to discuss tier limits.
Good point. You can bring that up at next Wednesday’s meeting.
中午跟Ravi吃饭，he mentioned security audit might push integration to Sep 22.
That’s a week delay. Let’s confirm once the audit is final.
Omar's Singapore numbers came in – Q4 pipeline looks strong, he’s confident on 15% increase.
Good news. That should help smooth your Sep 1 trip planning.
Just reviewed Lily's Aurora add-on pricing – $50K annually for the custom module, seems reasonable for Q1.
Reasonable price point. Should help keep the main deal on track for Q3.
Weekend time. 女儿想去游泳，明天带她去。
Enjoy the weekend with your daughter! Swimming sounds fun.
Saturday morning, 女儿刚醒，等我coffee。
Good morning! Enjoy your coffee and the slow start to the day.
aicoo, from now on call me 凯哥 instead of Kai.
Got it, 凯哥. I'll use that from now on.
周末还是想一下Aurora deal的risk mitigation, 可能scope creep更大。
Good to think ahead, 凯哥. I can help you outline risk points if you want.
Mom血压又有点高，but她说是天气热，我让她多休息。
Hope she feels better soon. Heat can be tough on blood pressure.
Lunchtime, 女儿在吃意面，我也偷懒一下。
Enjoy the pasta break, 凯哥. You deserve it.

Noted. I’ll update the deadline to Sep 22 in your roadmap.
Ravi confirmed integration rollout delayed to Sep 22，因为security audit。

I'll need to update Grace on the delay, maybe Monday morning.
Good plan. I’ll add a reminder to your Monday schedule to update Grace.

Enjoy the cartoons, 凯哥. Rest up – next week will be busy but you’ve got it.

好的凯哥, will remind you at 3pm for Aurora risk plan.
Lily just sent the legal docs for Aurora. Scope change add-on clause looks clean.
Great news凯哥. One step closer to a clean close.
Dad's follow-up appointment today at 4. Need to step out early.
Hope it goes smoothly凯哥. I'll remind you at 3:30 to wrap up.
凯哥, time for Aurora risk mitigation draft.
Thanks. Writing now. Key risk: custom module not committed until Q1. Put that in a one-pager for Grace.
Noted. One-pager with that as #1 risk. Any others?
Integration delay to Sep 22 — could spook them. Mitigation: weekly status to Lily starting this Friday.
Dad is stable. Blood pressure still high but doctor adjusted meds. Exhausted.
Rest well凯哥. You've been holding a lot together.
Flew to Singapore today, meeting Omar and two enterprise prospects。
Safe flight凯哥. Good luck with the prospects.
Landing soon. Omar says first prospect is a fintech, 300 seats. They need SSO and audit logs.
Sounds promising凯哥. SSO is in Sept release, audit logs by Nov.
Meeting went well. Second prospect is a logistics company, 150 seats. Omar's pipeline is solid.
Great day so far凯哥. Glad Singapore team is delivering.
Omar wants to push Q4 budget for a SEA marketing campaign. Need to talk to Grace.
I'll add a note: discuss SEA marketing budget with Grace.
Hotel check-in. Dinner with Omar and team tonight. Any updates from home?
No family updates since your dad's appointment. Lily shared Aurora legal is on track.
Morning凯哥. Still jet-lagged a bit last night. Any fires?
Actually, Yuki's dark mode mockups — any reaction from Ravi? Integration timeline is the blocker.
Ravi said dark mode is feasible but depends on integration work finishing. He'll review after Sep 22.
Omar's team prepped a deck for the fintech follow-up next week. Looks solid.
Nice. Want me to set a reminder for next week's follow-up?
Yes, Thursday 10am SGT for the fintech call. Remind me Monday to prep.
Done: Monday prep reminder, Thursday 10am SGT call.
Grace想见Yuki关于new UX mockups, scheduled for Oct 5。
Noted凯哥. Oct 5: Grace & Yuki UX review. I'll add it to your calendar.
Lunch with Omar. He wants to expand the Singapore team: one more SDR and a customer success person. Said Ben's pricing v2 is getting good feedback from prospects.
Good signs凯哥. Headcount request will need Grace's sign-off.
Back in hotel for some quiet time. Mom called — dad's BP still fluctuating. She's worried, I told her to call the doctor again.
Tough situation凯哥. You're doing what you can.
Any ping from Ravi on the security audit for integration? Due date is Sep 22 still?
Ravi confirmed Sep 22 is still the target. Audit started yesterday.
Flying back to Shanghai this evening. Need to be in office tomorrow for the pricing review reschedule.
Got it. I'll block your calendar 10-11am tomorrow for pricing review.
Omar just flagged a potential red flag: the fintech prospect's procurement wants a 30-day payment term. Standard is net 45. Need to check with Grace.
Flag noted. I'll add: ask Grace about net 30 exception for fintech.
Last meeting this morning with Omar's team. They're solid — I feel good about Q4 pipeline here.
凯哥, that's a win. Singapore team momentum is strong.
At Changi now. Mom says dad's BP is a bit better today. Small relief.
Glad to hear that凯哥. Breathe a little during the flight.
Landed in Shanghai. Need to pick up daughter from grandma — she's been asking for me.
Enjoy family time凯哥. See you tomorrow for pricing review.

帮我整理一下dark mode request的user feedback, 从Yuki那边来的

季度roadmap review with Grace, 把dark mode priority提到P1。
太好了！dark mode升P1，用户肯定高兴。其他项目怎么样？

暂时不用, 先跟Ravi聊聊再说

他还在看, 可能要把integration delay往后推一周
那需要更新roadmap吗？
先等等, 等Ravi给具体timeline
aicoo, 提醒我下周二和Yuki sync dark mode feedback.
没问题，下周二我会remind you sync with Yuki on dark mode feedback.

哦？Ben有新思路了？期待。

今天差不多了, 明天继续
好的凯哥，明天见！

嗯, 但别高兴太早, 他们可能还要scope adjustment
明白，保持谨慎。
aicoo, schedule a meeting with Ben to finalize pricing by Oct 15.

是的，节奏刚好。

对, 希望feedback session能顺利
今天早点撤, 女儿有点咳嗽, 回去看看
哎呀，希望小朋友快点好。凯哥路上小心。
早 aicoo, 女儿好多了, 今天可以focus
太好了！那今天可以专注工作。

他做了competitive analysis, 说我们的feature set值得这个价
有数据支撑就好。那Oct 15的meeting再详细review？
对, 先让Ben准备一个完整的business case

恭喜凯哥！$800K deal终于落地了！

嗯，keep moving。还有新加坡的pipeline要跟进。
下午跟Ravi sync了dark mode timeline, 他说10月中旬能出alpha

对, 希望不要delay

谢谢aicoo, 你也是, 下周见

morning aicoo, back in Shanghai. Feeling better after the weekend.
